audit_items.proof_trace: Deposit requests from P2P blocks are appended to pending_deposits queue (L589-598) without signature or merkle proof verification. Validation is deferred to epoch processing (ProcessPendingDeposits), violating the property's requirement to validate before processing. This creates a window of up to 32 slots where invalid deposits exist in state.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends P2P blocks with execution_payload.deposit_requests containing invalid signatures or garbage data. These bypass immediate validation and are appended to state, enabling state bloat attacks until the next epoch when signature verification finally occurs and silently drops them.
